name: Saber Alter
original_name: セイバー・オルタナティブ
source:
When Saber is consumed by [url=/c46]The Shadow[/url], she turns into [url=/c35]Sakura's[/url] Servant, Saber Alter, a corrupted version of her former self with unmatched strength.
